stages.log: A striking hall's food run is a pilot short. Fly it, and the union remembers who did. The hall's food run: marked on the chart, from the next sector on. Its steward would sign on, given a berth.

objectives.text: Fly it, sign on Teo, or Fly the food run
objectives.done-when: events.chose(event: foodrun, choice: carryjoin) or events.chose(event: foodrun, choice: carry)

stages.fail-when: events.chose(event: foodrun, choice: take) or run.past-charts
stages.why: It went cold: take the rations.
